replication.target_description: This effect investigates whether the type of object (food vs. ball) influences collection times. The food-versus-ball description indicates a pairwise contrast, whereas the printed partial eta-squared 0.16 belongs to the four-category omnibus main effect. The explicitly printed high-calorie-versus-ball contrast supplies W and r, not eta-squared; low-calorie food is a separate category and the description does not specify calorie level.
